faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers before you generate your chart.
faq.a1: Yes for accurate Lagna and house placements. If time is unknown, Moon-based themes can still be discussed in consultation.
faq.q2: Is this Vedic or Western astrology?
faq.a2: Astrologics uses Vedic astrology. Planet positions follow the fixed stars. Western astrology often uses a season-based Sun sign system — they are different.
faq.a3: We share high-level indications on the site. Personalized remedies are shared after a private consultation with us.
faq.a4: Your chart is calculated while you use the site. For consultations, we only use what you choose to share with us.
faq.q5: Can I get the report in Hindi?
faq.a5: Yes — switch language anytime. The pages and kundli explanations support Hindi and English.
faq.a6: Ayanamsa is the correction that aligns planet positions with the fixed stars. The Lahiri method is India’s most widely used official standard (also used in the national panchang). Our kundli uses this method.
